PluginData.Tooltip: Directs the chat personalities of BaR Maid, Fat Albert, Stockpile Manager, Script to Plugin and OreScout.
PluginData.Description:
The neighbour over the fence. Wilson directs the chat personalities of BaR Maid, Fat Albert, Sacrificial Stockpile Manager, Script to Plugin and OreScout, and has a few words of his own.
With Wilson loaded, the plugins tell him when something happens and he decides who speaks, now and then with a short exchange between several characters. Chat lines only show on your own screen, so it's fine on any server.
Open it with /wilson in chat.
Guide: https://github.com/scotlandsyard/SpaceEngineersPlugins/tree/main/Projects/Wilson Report bugs: https://github.com/scotlandsyard/SpaceEngineersPlugins/issues
